race.description: Nsw Jockey Association F&M Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BETTER BLOOM (1) returned from a spell three weeks ago when finishing back in the ruck at Newcastle. Finds a more suitable contest in his stable debut for Joe Cleary and gets a key booking in Loy. Can get the job done. BRILLIANT BEAGLE (9) finds the maiden win elusive but progressed nicely last time out to finish just half a length from the winner in third over 1175m at Albury after being in the firing line on the turn. Best figures measure up. ON HER MERITS (4) has been struggling against tougher opposition, so should appreciate the drop back to country level. Worth keeping an eye on. WESTERN LIGHTS (12) showed good tactical speed at Wagga last time and clung on to a minor placing at big odds. Deserves more respect this time.
